title: 现有 Plugin 能力强化迭代
summary: 在上一轮工具发现、backend profile、Worker backend、安全 guard 完成后，继续强化已有插件的实际分析输出。默认优先加深现有插件的结构化结果、跨插件 handoff、质量门和证据链；只有现有插件边界不合适时才建立新插件。
recommended_execution: 先增强 malware.intel.loop 的本地情报融合输出，再继续强化 unpacking、static-triage、code-analysis、dynamic/runtime planning、reporting/visualization 等已有插件的结构化证据链。

waves.name: Malware Intelligence Fusion
waves.goal: 增强现有 malware 插件，把 config/C2/behavior/strings/classification 证据融合成可路由、可验证的本地情报包。

waves.name: Unpacking And Static Triage Deepening
waves.goal: 强化 unpacking 与 static-triage 的 packer、re-triage、confidence、workflow handoff 能力。

waves.name: Reverse Workflow Evidence Chains
waves.goal: 强化 code-analysis、cross-decompiler、reporting/visualization 的 evidence graph 与 analyst handoff。

waves.name: Plugin Release Guard
waves.goal: 更新 docs/catalog/tests，确认本轮 Plugin 强化不扩大默认执行风险。

non_goals: Do not create new plugins unless an existing plugin boundary is wrong.
Do not widen the default MCP startup surface.
Do not start malware samples, dynamic runtimes, debuggers, emulators, or external threat-intel lookups from strengthened plugin paths.
Do not replace previous TASK-065 through TASK-074 outputs.
